summary: Deployed server components now record the bundle version they hold, and the previous build can be rolled back from one command.
details: Every deploy stamps the app folder's manifest with the bundle version from frontend/package.json, the build time, the machine, and the commit plus whether the working tree was dirty.
deploy_rollback.py status reports the deployed and parked build of each component and flags a split bundle or a server running behind the repository.
deploy_rollback.py rollback restores the parked previous build through each component's own deploy-time stopped window.
